description:
Purpose Statement:   To perform engineering design services and other related product development and/or product commercialization services. Please refer to discipline core skills for specifics.
 
 Key Job Accountabilities: 
 Develops engineering/product concepts that are high-quality, cost-appropriate, and satisfy the customer's requirements.
 Successfully executes responsibilities in adherence to Plexus' engineering process.
 Demonstrates a clear, discipline-specific understanding of the full value stream (Conceptualize, Design, Commercialize, Manufacture, Fulfill, Sustain) as it applies to their role.
 Utilizes appropriate tools and equipment to perform necessary design work including design creation, design analysis, and design verification.
 Produces comprehensive project documentation based on the needs of the project and in accordance with the quality and change management procedures and guidelines.
 
 Education/Experience Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s Degree required with 1 or more years of related experience preferred.
 
 Other Qualifications:  
 N/A
 
 Physical Requirements:  
 N/A
 
 Travel Requirements:  
 N/A
 
 This document does not represent a contract of employment and is not intended to capture every possible assignment the incumbent could be asked to perform.
